title: Import Bazaar prompt components and selections
summary: Import reviewed complete Cell prompt sets into one private database, reusing identical text and publishing each owner selection after every component exists. Recover by repeating the same import.
use_when: Reviewed complete prompt sets must be published before deploying a caller.
The same reviewed import must finish after interruption while preserving existing history.
do_not_use_when: The caller wants runtime text preparation or a raw single-string append.
The caller wants an automatic seed fallback, atomic all-requester cutover, caller deployment, history replacement, or agent execution.
outcome: The reviewed component versions and complete per-owner selections are available in the selected private Bazaar database.
effects: Initializes only the selected absent, empty, or compatible private database, preserves unrelated IDs, and appends changed component and selection strings.
Reuses identical latest component and selection content. No caller, schedule, library assignment, or model request is changed.
authority: Bazaar owns import validation, initialization, immutable version appends, and complete owner-selection publication. The user or application authorizes the reviewed content and selected database; products own caller deployment and domain meaning.
success: The importer completes and returns counts for distinct imported IDs, newly appended component versions, and owner selection sets processed. Verify required exact selections and component versions before deploying callers.
failure_and_recovery: Invalid input fails before initialization. Later failures can retain unused component versions or some published owner selections. Repeat the same reviewed import to finish and inspect history after uncertain writes.
Foreign or unsupported state remains an error. Do not recreate state, delete versions, or infer caller deployment from the receipt.
privacy: Import documents and stored content can be private. Protect them within the selected product boundary. Reports contain counts and no content; CLI usage recording is metadata-only and best effort.
does_not_authorize: Caller migration or deployment, library assignment, model or permission changes, history deletion or restoration, agent execution, external sending, or disclosure of private content.

consumers.statement: People, authorized agents, and local Rust applications import reviewed complete Cell prompt sets.

preconditions.statement: The user or application authorizes the reviewed content and selected absolute private database. The UTF-8 JSON document uses import schema one with nonempty unique component entries and known owners; each supplied owner set must be complete. State is absent, empty, or compatible schema one.

inputs.statement: The CLI accepts one import JSON path and global --database, defaulting to ~/.local/share/bazaar/bazaar.sqlite3. Rust import takes database and input Paths. Each entry has id and complete content; allowed first ID segments are annals, conatus, krisis, semantics, platter, weaver, emt, and telete. Unknown fields, duplicate IDs, unknown owners, and unsupported or empty imports fail.

outputs.statement: ImportReport has imported_ids, appended_text_versions, and owner_selections. CLI text prints counts; --json uses schema-one success or operational-error envelopes. Operational errors exit 1 and syntax errors exit 2. Rust returns prompts::Result<ImportReport> with typed errors.

data_semantics.statement: The importer reuses identical latest component content or appends a new immutable complete version, then publishes schema-one cell.prompts.OWNER selections containing exactly the supplied owner component map. An identical latest selection is reused. A partial owner set omits old keys from its next selection.

identity_and_units.statement: Component ID and positive version identify exact text; owner selection ID and version identify a complete selected set. imported_ids counts distinct document IDs, appended_text_versions counts new component appends excluding selections, and owner_selections counts processed owner sets including identical ones. No timestamp or model-usage unit is supplied.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: The report covers this completed import only. Every component exists before any owner selection is published. Required selected versions must be read before caller deployment. Another writer can change latest after a receipt; imports emit no timestamp or cross-owner cutover claim.

access.statement: The local CLI and in-process API use current-user private regular filesystem paths. Writer::initialize creates missing directories with mode 0700 and state with mode 0600; existing private-path and supported-state rules apply. CLI recording omits arguments and content; direct Rust imports record no CLI usage.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Input validation precedes initialization. Components and owner selections use separate append transactions. Interrupted imports can leave unused versions or some published owner selections. Repeating identical reviewed content reuses existing latest records; committed history remains immutable. There is no atomic all-requester publication.

operational_limits.statement: The whole JSON input and content are held in memory. SQLite waits up to five seconds for contention. No import-size, capacity, throughput, completion-time, automatic caller deployment, or cross-owner atomicity guarantee is supplied.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Import schema one, selection schema one, database schema one, string versions, product release, and capability version are independent. Import preserves existing IDs and versions. Import the original seed before later edits and retain selection version one and its components for historical callers. Program rollback does not restore prior content.

reliances.statement: The importer uses local files and Bazaar state only. It invokes no external service, model, Nucleus library, or installed catalog.
